notes: NEX1_DECLARATION contract · founder-authorised 2026-09-12 constitutional distinction. NEX1 MAY claim things about its own work. Only the Evidence Engine MAY produce independently measured EvidenceRecords. A NEX1Declaration is a CLAIM · not evidence · never accepted as an EvidenceRecord.
purpose: surface NEX1's beliefs about its own output so downstream tooling can compare against independent measurement · never so downstream tooling can skip measurement

required_fields.name: candidate_id
required_fields.shape: string · always 'cand_nex1' for NEX1's own output

required_fields.name: claim_type
required_fields.shape: enum · IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETE · TESTS_EXPECTED_TO_PASS · SEMANTIC_PRESERVATION_CLAIMED · COMPLEXITY_EXPECTED_TO_IMPROVE · COMPILATION_EXPECTED · TYPE_CHECK_EXPECTED · CUSTOM
required_fields.notes: explicit list · CUSTOM requires a claim_text field · never inflates the list at runtime

required_fields.name: self_reported_state
required_fields.notes: even NEX1's self-report can be CLAIMED (I believe) · UNCERTAIN (I don't know) · WITHDRAWN (I retract my earlier claim)

hard_invariants: a NEX1Declaration MUST NEVER be accepted as an EvidenceRecord by any consumer · Evidence Engine · NEX2 · NEX3 · Standard Feed
record_type=NEX1_DECLARATION MUST NEVER be silently rewritten to record_type=EVIDENCE_RECORD
no NEX1Declaration field is a substitute for tool + tool_version + reproducibility_information from the Evidence Engine
NEX1Declaration NEVER carries a measurement.value that satisfies EvidenceRecord requirements
state=PASSED cannot come from a NEX1Declaration · only from an Evidence Engine measurement
consumers checking for evidence MUST validate record_type === 'EVIDENCE_RECORD' · declarations MUST be rejected
consumption_rules: NEX2 may READ NEX1 declarations for context · never CITE them as evidence in its review
NEX3 may READ NEX1 declarations for context · never CITE them as evidence in its arbitration
the Evidence Engine may READ NEX1 declarations to prioritise which dimensions to measure first · never as substitute measurement
founder ADR MAY quote NEX1 declarations · that is a founder authority · not an evidence claim
